neighbourhood(cells: List[bool], at: int) -> int is
    let left = cells[(at + cells.count - 1) % cells.count]
    let right = cells[(at + 1) % cells.count]

    return
        (if left then 4 else 0 fi) +
        (if cells[at] then 2 else 0 fi) +
        (if right then 1 else 0 fi)
si

step(rule: int, cells: List[bool]) -> List[bool] is
    let next = LIST(cells.count)

    for at in 0..cells.count do
        next.add((rule >> neighbourhood(cells, at)) & 1 == 1)
    od

    return next
